Message:
refactor(Wind): Strip Effect monad from Commands service

Remove the Effect.Effect return types from the CommandsService interface and
the corresponding Effect pipeline wrappers in the Live implementation.
RegisterCommand and UnregisterCommand become void-returning sync calls;
ExecuteCommand and GetCommands return native Promise<T> instead of
Effect<T, CommandsProblem>.

Delete the CommandsServiceTag, LiveCommandsServiceLayer, and
CommandsOperationFailed error type. Replace MakeCommandsOperationFailed
with a plain MakeCommandsError helper. The module now exports
CommandsServiceInstance directly.

This aligns with the ongoing de-Effectification of low-level Wind service
bindings that delegate directly to Tauri IPC — async/await is sufficient
where no composition or retry/scheduling guarantees are required.
